newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil stevedores to protest in Santos city center.
newsitem.headline: Brazil stevedores to protest in Santos city center.

text.p: Stevedores at Brazil's Santos port will hold a demonstration in the city center to protest the deadlock in talks with steel firm Companhia Siderurgica Paulista (Cosipa) since a strike last week, officials said.
There will be a public protest in front of the mayor's office at 1700 local/2000 GMT, a union official said.

Stevedores have been occupying two vessels at Cosipa's private terminal at the port since last week, in protest against the firm's decision to use its own workers to conduct loading and unloading at the terminal.
The action has effectively paralyzed Cosipa's operations at the port. Military police officers are stationed on the pier but have so far failed to carry out a judge's order to evacuate the workers.

The stevedores said they would immediately call a strike if the police tried to evict them or if Cosipa allowed any new vessels to dock at the terminal and tried to load or unload them with its own workers.

The Santos port authority said there were now four vessels waiting to dock at the Cosipa terminal, two carrying iron ore, one coal and one metal products. Cosipa has made no request to the port for any of the vessels to dock, a spokesman said.
